title: Count Nice Subarrays (K Odd Numbers)

monster.name: Parity Specter
monster.title: Tallyman of Odd Number Pulses
monster.defeatQuote: Prefix odd counts revealed all matching intervals!

description: Given an array of integers `nums` and an integer `k`. A continuous subarray is called nice if there are `k` odd numbers on it. Return the number of nice sub-arrays.
starterCode:
def numberOfSubarrays(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    pass
solutionCode:
def numberOfSubarrays(nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
    from collections import defaultdict
    count = defaultdict(int)
    count[0] = 1
    curr = 0
    ans = 0
    for n in nums:
        curr += (n % 2)
        ans += count[curr - k]
        count[curr] += 1
    return ans
hints: Convert to 0s and 1s (n % 2) and use a prefix sum map for sum equals k.
